changedPaths.behavior: Replaces a separate clean build plus test sequence with trait-aware swift test, reducing duplicate compilation.
changedPaths.rationale: The CI optimization is Swift-specific; only the invariant of testing production feature combinations is portable.

changedPaths.behavior: Pins the Xcode Swift language version for reproducible clean CI builds.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake uses Rust/Node toolchains, so the file is not portable.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds a chroma-distance floor to suppress near-black key noise and adjusts matte/alpha output.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake's RGB similarity/smoothness/spill shader is real but not proven visually equivalent to the new chroma-space floor.

changedPaths.behavior: Prunes/resolves dependencies after moving speech and telemetry dependencies behind package traits.
changedPaths.rationale: Lockfile churn belongs to SwiftPM, though dependency closure should be verified in OpenTake builds.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds BundledSpeech and ProductionTelemetry traits and conditionally enables their dependencies/imports.
changedPaths.rationale: Product-level feature gating is relevant, but SwiftPM declarations are not.

changedPaths.behavior: Replaces the public star-history image token with a sealed token URL.
changedPaths.rationale: Palmier repository analytics artwork has no OpenTake product behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Defaults hosted chat to Sonnet 5 and restores in-app activation telemetry without double-counting restored chats.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: crates/opentake-agent/src; none for hosted model/activation telemetry
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake is currently BYOK/local-agent oriented; hosted model choice and activation accounting need an explicit service decision.

changedPaths.behavior: Separates HTTP connection lifetime from recognized MCP-session activation counting.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has MCP transport but no equivalent activation telemetry boundary.

changedPaths.behavior: Tracks per-session project selection, consolidates project tools, and records MCP activation only on the first recognized tool call.
changedPaths.rationale: The dispatcher is session-scoped but does not pin/project-authorize writes or count first-use activation.

changedPaths.behavior: Rewrites instructions for manage_tracks, consolidated manage_project, and queued manage_exports.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake's advertised 31-tool set predates all three upstream contract changes.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds/updates schemas for stable track addressing, project management, export queue control, and audio cleanup/dubbing source arguments.
changedPaths.rationale: Missing tool names/schemas are a direct contract gap; generation tools are also still unwired.

changedPaths.behavior: Resolves track targets by trackId or exact legacy integer index and rejects fractional/out-of-zone indices.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake still exposes index-based mutations even though get_timeline returns track IDs.

changedPaths.behavior: Routes export commands into the shared queue and implements manage_exports list/cancel/remove/clear operations.
changedPaths.rationale: Single-export cancellation exists, but queue state and the agent management surface do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Accepts sourceMediaRef and targetLanguage, validates audio transforms, and submits cleanup/dubbing generations.
changedPaths.rationale: Provider plumbing exists, but agent generation is explicitly not implemented and lacks these arguments.

changedPaths.behavior: Routes imported asset metadata through the new batched manifest updater.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake imports transactionally but directly mutates the manifest rather than batching metadata.

changedPaths.behavior: Moves project setting mutations under consolidated project management and selected-project write authority.
changedPaths.rationale: Core settings exist, but no session-pinned agent project authority wraps them.

changedPaths.behavior: Replaces separate list/create/open/close tools with manage_project; allows inactive reads, blocks inactive writes, and saves before close.
changedPaths.rationale: Project primitives exist, but the consolidated agent operation and authority/persistence guarantees do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Includes stable track IDs and audio-transform source references in short-ID expansion/shortening.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has a short-ID engine but its universe/contracts lack the new tool surfaces.

changedPaths.behavior: Returns track receipts for reorder/removal and wraps timeline creation/duplication in explicit single agent undo groups.
changedPaths.rationale: Assistant-only undo already exists, but receipts/consolidated track operations and event-group parity do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Centralizes tool telemetry with source/status/duration/change/failure fields, registers new project/export tools, and fixes NSUndoManager group boundaries.
changedPaths.rationale: The uniform dispatcher and undo stack exist; telemetry and new tool registrations do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Begins termination gating and waits for active MLX speaker/VAD work to drain before exit.
changedPaths.rationale: Graceful worker drain is portable, but OpenTake uses different inference/runtime processes.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes visible/frontmost project state available to agent session authorization and project listing.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake tracks project epochs/sessions, but not the same multi-window agent visibility/write rule.

changedPaths.behavior: Wraps MLX speaker embedding operations in the termination gate and conditionally compiles bundled speech.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: OpenTake transcription/speaker analysis paths; none for MLX
changedPaths.rationale: MLX-specific code cannot port directly; shutdown and feature-gate invariants remain.

changedPaths.behavior: Gates VAD MLX work, adds chunk cancellation checks, and conditionally compiles the bundled model.
changedPaths.rationale: Per-chunk cancellation is relevant but must target OpenTake's actual backend.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes speech-enhancement implementation conditional on the bundled-speech package trait.
changedPaths.rationale: No exact OpenTake enhancer surface exists.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds 48 kHz stereo peak analysis, dB mapping, decay, 1.5 s peak hold, clipping indication/reset, and coalesced invalidation.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has playback audio but no level-meter state or analysis.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds the timeline-side level/peak/clipping visual meter.
changedPaths.rationale: User-visible monitoring is absent.

changedPaths.behavior: Moves backend configuration into a shared backend namespace for generation workflows; content is unchanged.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake already centralizes provider configuration independently of account UI.

changedPaths.behavior: Introduces shared backend error decoding used by storage and generation requests.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake already has provider-neutral generation errors.

changedPaths.behavior: Moves storage upload/download into shared backend code and extends it for transform source media.
changedPaths.rationale: BYOK adapters own transport, but reusable source upload/lifetime semantics need work.

changedPaths.behavior: Changes chroma defaults, including softness 0.1, to match sampled-key workflow.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake defaults smoothness to 0.35 and includes spill, so a blind default copy would change its visual model.

changedPaths.behavior: Temporarily disables the selected clip's chroma effect while sampling and premultiplies alpha after transforms/effects.
changedPaths.rationale: Sampling needs an unkeyed frame; alpha-order parity is render-critical and needs GPU image tests.

changedPaths.behavior: Raises accepted .cube dimension ceiling from 64 to 128, allowing standard 65-point LUTs.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has no .cube LUT loader or import path.

changedPaths.behavior: Places the audio meter beside the timeline and binds it to preview playback/scrub audio.
changedPaths.rationale: Timeline/preview controls exist but expose no meter.

changedPaths.behavior: Cancels chroma sampling on selection/window changes and contributes frontmost-window project state for agent authorization.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: web selection state; none for eyedropper/project authority
changedPaths.rationale: Both lifecycle cancellations and window authority are missing as explicit contracts.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds export activity/history affordance and status dot linked to shared queue jobs.
changedPaths.rationale: Export entry exists; queue activity/history feedback does not.

changedPaths.behavior: Allows AI Edit on standalone audio or linked A/V and dispatches cleanup/dubbing edit kinds.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: web/src/components/inspector; none for AI audio transforms
changedPaths.rationale: No equivalent edit action exists in the current web editor.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds sampling mode lifecycle; averages a 9×9 active-frame region, derives hue, and commits hue/tolerance/softness defaults.
changedPaths.rationale: Existing manual color input does not replace click-to-sample behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Applies folder-derived metadata updates through the batch manifest path.
changedPaths.rationale: Folder mutation exists, but batching/flush semantics do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Queues metadata updates, batches after 20 ms or 64 items, avoids stale/deleted assets, and lowers production logging.
changedPaths.rationale: Direct session mutations are safe but can cause repeated copies/writes and lack stale-batch guards.

changedPaths.behavior: Owns chroma/audio/export state and flushes pending manifest metadata before undo snapshots and saves.
changedPaths.rationale: Multiple new state machines cross OpenTake's web/Rust boundary; only base edit/session state exists.

changedPaths.behavior: Removes the prior single-export coordinator in favor of shared FIFO job management.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake's control is deliberately operation-scoped and should be extended, not deleted blindly.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds FIFO jobs, per-project status/progress/history, active/waiting cancellation, destination reservation, remove/clear, and completion publication.
changedPaths.rationale: Safe single-operation primitives are a base, but queue semantics are missing.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes all export formats queue-executable and cancellation-aware while preserving existing destination content until staged commit.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake already uses generation-scoped cancellation and staged commit to protect prior output.

changedPaths.behavior: Replaces modal-only progress with queue submission plus log/cancel/remove/clear UI.
changedPaths.rationale: Form and live cancel exist; multi-job log/history controls do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Threads cooperative cancellation through HDR export work.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake cancellation checks are format-agnostic in its export operation, though HDR parity itself is separate.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes project-bundle export cancellable and transactional within queue jobs.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake UI explicitly says project bundling has no cooperative cancel even though video export does.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds cleanup/dubbing input capability, source requirements, target-language validation, and duration-preservation rules.
changedPaths.rationale: Catalog machinery exists, but these model capabilities/constraints are absent.

changedPaths.behavior: Accounts for source-duration cleanup/dubbing requests in estimated cost.
changedPaths.rationale: Money-impacting estimates must match provider rules before exposing the workflow.

changedPaths.behavior: Registers ElevenLabs voice-isolation and dubbing models/categories.
changedPaths.rationale: ElevenLabs TTS/music/SFX exist, but cleanup/dubbing catalog entries do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds cleanup/dub actions with media eligibility and target-language flow.
changedPaths.rationale: Missing user entry point.

changedPaths.behavior: Defines cleanup versus dubbing behavior, titles, language requirements, and model mapping.
changedPaths.rationale: Product/domain concept is missing.

changedPaths.behavior: Extracts the selected/linked source, submits transform generation, and places the result while preserving source length.
changedPaths.rationale: Requires a new vertical path across extraction, provider submission, import, and timeline placement.

changedPaths.behavior: Splits rerun behavior from the submitter while preserving prior generation inputs, including transform inputs.
changedPaths.rationale: Generation log exists, but rerun execution/UI is not wired.

changedPaths.behavior: Splits seed derivation/reuse helpers out of the submitter during transform refactor.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake supports provider parameters; exact helper organization is not portable.

changedPaths.behavior: Splits upscale submission from the common submitter during transform refactor.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: crates/opentake-agent/src/mcp/dispatch.rs UpscaleMedia stub; generation provider paths
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake advertises upscale but the agent body is explicitly unwired.

changedPaths.behavior: Refactors common submit flow to dispatch rerun/upscale/audio-transform specializations and persist richer inputs.
changedPaths.rationale: Building blocks exist without the full editor submission orchestrator.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds backend procedures/arguments for cleanup and dubbing source uploads, including target language.
changedPaths.rationale: Palmier Convex/backend calls cannot be copied; direct ElevenLabs BYOK endpoints need separate implementation.

changedPaths.behavior: Persists completed-generation metadata through batched manifest updates.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake generation integration is incomplete and manifest writes are direct.

changedPaths.behavior: Extracts upload-ready audio from video sources for isolation/dubbing.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: src-tauri/src/playback/audio.rs decode helpers; none for provider upload extraction
changedPaths.rationale: Decode infrastructure exists, but a bounded temporary-file/upload contract is missing.

changedPaths.behavior: Represents exact selected clip/media ranges and preserves source duration across preprocessing.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: crates/opentake-domain/src/clip.rs trim fields; media resolution helpers
changedPaths.rationale: Timeline trim semantics exist; generation preprocessing does not consume them end-to-end.

changedPaths.behavior: Moves unchanged video compression under the shared preprocessing namespace.
changedPaths.rationale: Pure organization change; no framework-structure port needed.

changedPaths.behavior: Moves trim extraction to shared preprocessing and adapts it to generic trimmed source/audio-transform use.
changedPaths.rationale: Behavior is reusable, but OpenTake needs cross-platform ffmpeg-backed extraction.

changedPaths.behavior: Supports source-backed audio generation categories, target language, and source-length defaults.
changedPaths.rationale: Existing request types do not model these transform inputs.

changedPaths.behavior: Persists source-media and target-language metadata for rerun/audit of audio transforms.
changedPaths.rationale: Persistence containers exist, but schema/round-trip fields need extension.

changedPaths.behavior: Selects/validates cleanup and dubbing models based on source kind and language.
changedPaths.rationale: Catalog alone does not provide model-state UI.

changedPaths.behavior: Allows audio/video transform source selection and derives eligible references.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: web media library/store; generation UI none
changedPaths.rationale: Missing reference picker behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds target-language settings and hides irrelevant prompt controls for transform models.
changedPaths.rationale: Missing conditional settings UI and validation.

changedPaths.behavior: Builds source-backed cleanup/dubbing submissions and validates required language/source before spending.
changedPaths.rationale: Cost-bearing validation must be implemented end-to-end.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds cleanup/dubbing categories and state wiring to the main generation panel.
changedPaths.rationale: No equivalent integrated generation panel is present.

changedPaths.behavior: Extends reference controls to accept and label audio/video transform sources.
changedPaths.rationale: Missing source UI.

changedPaths.behavior: Wires the chroma eyedropper action into the inspector and also exposes new audio transform edit state.
changedPaths.rationale: Manual swatch is integrated; eyedropper and transform actions are absent.

changedPaths.behavior: Presents audio cleanup/dubbing actions for eligible timeline selections and target language.
changedPaths.rationale: Missing inspector entry point.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds the eyedropper control and aligns chroma tolerance/softness labels/defaults.
changedPaths.rationale: Enable and numeric controls exist; sampling control and semantic parity do not.

changedPaths.behavior: Extends stored generation input with target language/source transform metadata.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake schema has generation input support but lacks these new fields.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes resolver/export reads cancellation-aware for queued export operations.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake guards decode/render work with operation cancellation through a different resolver design.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds crosshair/hover overlay that converts preview clicks into sampled image coordinates and handles escape/tab cancellation.
changedPaths.rationale: This is missing user-visible preview interaction, not a macOS-only product behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Installs/removes the sampler overlay with selection/playhead state and suppresses conflicting preview interactions.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake preview has scrub/zoom interaction but no sampling mode.

changedPaths.behavior: Exposes hit-test mapping needed to identify the selected clip pixel under the preview point.
changedPaths.rationale: Coordinate mapping must be adapted to DOM/canvas and Rust-render paths.

changedPaths.behavior: Implements cached PCM windows and short direction-aware faded grains for step/scrub playback; later delegates device work off-main.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake explicitly silences audio during scrub; native playback audio can be reused but not assumed safe.

changedPaths.behavior: Owns Core Audio queue operations off the main thread, coalesces to latest pending grain, and invalidates on lifecycle/device changes.
changedPaths.rationale: Threading/lifecycle invariant is portable; Core Audio implementation is not.

changedPaths.behavior: Produces unkeyed active-frame samples for the eyedropper and initializes audible scrub support.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake preview is split between web and native paths; both behaviors cross that boundary.

changedPaths.behavior: Ensures close/save snapshots flush pending manifest metadata and repeats save until no concurrent unsaved changes remain.
changedPaths.rationale: Atomic save exists, but no documented loop/barrier against concurrent post-snapshot mutation.

changedPaths.behavior: Advances marketing/build versions from 0.6.4/65 through 0.6.6/67.
changedPaths.rationale: Upstream release numbers must not be copied into OpenTake.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes visual indexing wait for shared export activity to drain.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake already provides a shared reference-counted export pause primitive for indexing.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes model preflight usable from detached work and returns immutable spec/readiness data for later revalidation.
changedPaths.rationale: Spec types exist; the actual detached preflight runtime is explicitly deferred.

changedPaths.behavior: Runs disk/model preflight off-main, snapshots asset/spec, revalidates before commit, reschedules stale work, drains cancellation, waits export, and reduces production logs.
changedPaths.rationale: The file itself documents that OpenTake ships only the scheduling kernel and defers the queue/runtime.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds tool-call dimensions and MCP/in-app activation events, conditionally compiled for production telemetry.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake describes telemetry as a possible observer but ships no analytics capture implementation.

changedPaths.behavior: Makes telemetry imports/initialization conditional on the production package trait.
changedPaths.rationale: Requires an OpenTake privacy/consent and deployment decision before implementation.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds cleanup/dub context-menu actions for standalone audio and linked A/V clips.
changedPaths.rationale: Timeline menu exists but has no audio transform actions.

changedPaths.behavior: Exposes source-audio extraction support used by the new audio transformation generation path.
changedPaths.rationale: Transcription exists, but extraction for provider upload is a different lifecycle/format contract.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds shared colors/layout constants used by eyedropper, audio meter, and export activity UI.
changedPaths.rationale: Theme constants are implementation details; only new controls/feedback need behavioral coverage.

changedPaths.behavior: Generalizes capsule-button presentation for new audio transform actions.
changedPaths.rationale: Styling implementation is not a behavior gap by itself.

changedPaths.behavior: Generalizes hover highlight used by new generation/reference controls.
changedPaths.rationale: Styling implementation is already idiomatic in web UI.

changedPaths.behavior: Compiles debug autoclosures and stderr mirroring only in debug, reducing production overhead.
changedPaths.rationale: Rust logging already uses a different compile/runtime filtering model; no line-for-line port is justified.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds a gate rejecting new MLX operations after termination starts and awaits the active-operation count reaching zero.
changedPaths.rationale: Exact runtime is Apple MLX; behavior should be reconsidered against OpenTake's workers/processes.

changedPaths.behavior: Verifies one activation per recognized MCP session and avoids connection/restoration double counts.
changedPaths.rationale: Test evidence for a telemetry behavior OpenTake does not implement.

changedPaths.behavior: Updates agent project export tests for enqueue/queue-result semantics and cancellation.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: src-tauri/src/export.rs tests; none for agent export queue
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake tests single-operation export but lacks the tested agent queue behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Covers consolidated project actions, selected-project pinning, inactive-write rejection, save-before-close, and activation counting.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: crates/opentake-core/src/session.rs tests; none for agent project tool
changedPaths.rationale: Core project tests do not establish agent/multi-window authority semantics.

changedPaths.behavior: Covers stable-ID addressing, exact legacy indices, invalid fractional/index cases, reorder and removal receipts.
changedPaths.rationale: Existing OpenTake tests cover separate index-based tools, not the new contract.

changedPaths.behavior: Refreshes registered tool/schema expectations for exports, projects, tracks, and generation sources.
changedPaths.rationale: This is contract evidence; OpenTake's pinned 31-tool expectation is now stale relative to head.

changedPaths.behavior: Regression-tests automatic event-group closure and one-step undo for agent-created/duplicated timelines.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake snapshots each changed command and keeps a dispatcher-local agent undo stack, avoiding NSUndoManager event groups.

changedPaths.behavior: Verifies peak/dB conversion, decay, hold, clipping reset, and invalidation coalescing.
changedPaths.rationale: Defines acceptance tests for missing meter behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Verifies latest-grain coalescing, invalidation, and output state transitions without main-thread Core Audio calls.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake playback tests do not cover scrub-grain ownership/state.

changedPaths.behavior: Exercises FIFO order, destination conflicts, per-project views, waiting/active cancellation, remove, clear, and progress.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: src-tauri/src/export.rs cancellation tests; none for queue
changedPaths.rationale: Existing tests prove control safety, not scheduler behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds cancellation/staging round trips proving an existing destination survives aborted export.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake already has high-signal tests for generation isolation and commit refusal after cancel.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds project-bundle cancellation and existing-output preservation coverage.
changedPaths.openTakeEquivalent: src-tauri/src/export.rs archive tests; none for bundle cooperative cancel
changedPaths.rationale: The bundle-specific cancellation gap remains despite shared staging concepts.

changedPaths.behavior: Tests batch coalescing, deletion/replacement staleness, threshold flush, undo/save flush, and restore updates.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake tests direct manifest operations, not this concurrency/performance contract.

changedPaths.behavior: Verifies final save before close and catches edits arriving during an in-flight save.
changedPaths.rationale: Current tests prove round-trip/atomic write but not concurrent close persistence.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds regression vectors for black retention and keyed-color matte behavior.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has GPU chroma tests, but not the new near-black regression/vector semantics.

changedPaths.behavior: Verifies corrected post-effect alpha premultiplication and compositing output.
changedPaths.rationale: The invariant is cross-platform and needs image-based parity coverage.

changedPaths.behavior: Adjusts render histogram expectations after chroma/alpha output correction.
changedPaths.rationale: Evidence is tied to Palmier renderer output; OpenTake needs its own fixtures.

changedPaths.behavior: Proves 65-point LUT parsing and upper-bound validation.
changedPaths.rationale: Test accompanies missing LUT behavior.

changedPaths.behavior: Adds stale-snapshot/reschedule and off-main preflight regression coverage.
changedPaths.rationale: Current OpenTake tests cover eligibility/export-pause only.

changedPaths.behavior: Updates chroma mutation/default expectations used by edit and undo paths.
changedPaths.rationale: Chroma mutation exists, but upstream default/field model changed.

changedPaths.behavior: Covers rejection after termination and waiting for active MLX operations to drain.
changedPaths.rationale: Platform-specific test evidence; portable shutdown acceptance still needs definition.

changedPaths.behavior: Publishes signed Sparkle entries for Palmier 0.6.5 and 0.6.6.
changedPaths.rationale: OpenTake has no equivalent Sparkle feed in this tree and cannot reuse Palmier signatures or URLs.
